Featured project

LabGuard AI

A portfolio project exploring how machine learning and document-grounded generative AI can support laboratory anomaly investigation and quality documentation.

Laboratory anomaly detection & quality document assistant

LabGuard AI brings together an anomaly-detection workflow and a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) assistant in one application. It is designed to support investigation, not to replace professional judgement or laboratory validation.

PythonStreamlitFastAPI Isolation ForestFAISSRAG Sentence TransformersMistral
  • Explores statistical anomaly detection in laboratory results using Isolation Forest.
  • Retrieves relevant quality-document passages with FAISS and multilingual embeddings.
  • Uses Mistral to generate grounded answers and assist with investigation reports.
  • Exposes application functionality through FastAPI endpoints and a Streamlit interface.
  • Includes a RAGAS evaluation workflow to assess retrieval and answer quality.
